title: LeaderRoundDecision
description: Leader LLM output after reviewing all worker results for one round.

overall_assessment.description: Leader's natural-language analysis of this round (trends, bottlenecks, key observations). 2-5 sentences.

global_score_trend.description: Trend of the global objective across recent rounds.

stop_or_continue.description: Whether to proceed to the next round or stop.

stop_reason.description: If stop, explain why (e.g., target reached, plateau detected).

worker_guidance.description: Per-worker guidance for the next round.

priority_focus.description: What this worker should focus on next round (e.g., 'reduce peak overshoot', 'improve low flow', 'decrease PBIAS').

reasoning.description: Brief physical reasoning for this adjustment.

search_radius_hint.description: Whether to shrink, expand, or keep the search radius for this worker.

phase_recommendation.description: Whether to stay in the current calibration phase or advance to the next phase. Set 'advance' when current phase parameters have converged. Only relevant during VIC_ONLY and ROUTING_ONLY phases.

next_round_strategy.description: High-level strategy for next round (e.g., 'fine-tune around current best', 'explore wider for soil_d3', 'lock upstream and focus outlet').
